title: Testing
explain: JUnit 5 is the standard Java test framework. Methods marked `@Test` run independently, and assertions such as `assertEquals` fail the test when the result is wrong. `@ParameterizedTest` runs one test with many inputs.
exercise: Write a `clamp(n, min, max)` method with three tests, including a value below the range.
tip: Put the expected value first: `assertEquals(expected, actual)`. Swapping them makes failure messages misleading.
